opportunity.title: Short-Form Video Content Package for Small Businesses
opportunity.target_customer: Small business owners and emerging content creators looking to enhance their social media presence.
opportunity.customer_problem: Struggling to create engaging short-form video content that captures their brand's essence and connects with their target audience.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Offer a complete package that includes 5 custom short-form video scripts, optimized captions, and a social media strategy tailored for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
deliverables: 5 scripted short-form video ideas (15-60 seconds each)
Social media posting strategy (including best times to post and engagement tips)
1 revision of the scripts and captions based on customer feedback
opportunity.next_action: Create a detailed outline of the package and prepare a sample video script as a showcase.
